layers.authority: Government of Turkmenistan (as reported by Smartraveller)
layers.process: Designated restricted zones are closed to foreigners who don't have government permission. Smartraveller lists areas of Dashoguz (Dasoguz) among them, along with regions bordering Afghanistan, Iran and Uzbekistan and areas of the Caspian Sea coast.
